title: Robert Pattinson Named as the Next James Bond
summary: The announcement ends years of speculation over who would take over the role after Daniel Craig’s five-film run.

After seven years of rumors, wish lists and wild guesses, Hollywood’s most feverishly followed casting search is over: Amazon MGM Studios has chosen Robert Pattinson to play James Bond.


Pattinson, the 40-year-old English actor, will become the seventh man to play 007 in the official 25-film series. Pattinson is known for blockbusters like “Twilight,” “The Batman” and, most recently, “The Odyssey.”


He succeeds Daniel Craig, who[announced in 2019](https://www.the-independent.com/arts-entertainment/films/news/daniel-craig-james-bond-25-no-time-to-die-007-spectre-knives-out-release-date-trailer-a9213181.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com) that he would depart the role. Craig’s decision set off a frenzy of speculation among Bond enthusiasts, bookmakers and the British tabloids. Who could be trusted to step into the multibillion-dollar franchise? What kind of Bond would click with a new generation?[Should Bond be Black](https://www.menshealth.com/entertainment/a38472289/next-james-bond-ethnicity/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) ?[Or female](https://www.washingtonpost.com/arts-entertainment/2019/09/09/woman-could-play-james-bond-say-two-james-bonds/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) ?


At various points, the supposed candidates included Idris Elba, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Tom Hardy, Regé-Jean Page, Tom Holland, Jacob Elordi and Theo James.


Pattinson was chosen over Nicholas Hoult, Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor and Callum Turner. The five actors underwent screen tests in London in late October. The auditions involved stunts, dialogue and camera presence; they were overseen by Nina Gold, an Oscar-nominated (“Hamnet”) and Emmy-winning (“Game of Thrones”) casting director. Bond auditions can be revealing: Henry Cavill, who lost the role to Craig in the previous casting search,[told Men’s Health](https://www.menshealth.com/entertainment/a29774618/henry-cavill-the-witcher-superman-interview/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) in 2019 that he was asked to re-enact a scene in which Sean Connery’s Bond emerged from a bathroom in nothing but a towel.


James Bond is one of the most coveted — and unforgiving — roles in moviedom. When Craig was cast in 2005, taking over from Pierce Brosnan,[detractors complained](https://www.theguardian.com/film/2006/nov/02/jamesbond.news?utm_source=chatgpt.com) that he was too blond, too short and insufficiently suave. Carping fans have long been part of the Bond tradition, but the internet gave them a new megaphone. Craig’s “fleshy” ears and “potato” face were mocked on message boards. One group even created a[protest website](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/angry-bond-fans-threaten-007-boycott/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) , CraigNotBond.com.
